judge.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token usage across tool rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts` while preserving `undefined` when no rounds report usage and leaving single-round behavior unchanged. It meets every acceptance criterion, including testing a turn with two tool rounds (three provider calls), handling missing intermediate usage, updating `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and clarifying the hook's signature. Compared to the reference, which simply renamed the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` and added tests directly to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the candidate introduced a `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias and a separate acceptance test file (`chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts`). Also, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate left the `afterModelResponse` bullet under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section instead of moving it up to the main specification list as the reference did, and missed updating the doc-block in `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` and `CLAUDE.md`.
